//: ShelvesHub configuration. Precedence per setting: environment variable > this file > built-in default. Remove a key to use its default. Keys starting with // are comments (ignored by the parser — JSON has no real comments). Installed next to the binary; the daemon also honours SHELVES_CONFIG_FILE. See docs/troubleshooting.md.
// rpc_host: Host the local RPC server binds to — the injected bundle talks to it on the same machine. Loopback by default; rarely changed.
// rpc_port: Port for the local RPC server. Change this if another program already uses 60123 (you'll see a bind error in the log).
// cef_host: Host of Steam's CEF remote-debugging endpoint that the daemon injects into. Loopback by default.
// cef_port: Port of Steam's CEF remote-debugging endpoint. 8080 by default. Change it if Steam exposes remote debugging on a different port (you'll see 'Connection refused' on 127.0.0.1:8080 in the log).
// interval_secs: Seconds between injection-loop ticks — how often the daemon looks for the Steam renderer and (re)injects the runtime + bundle. Lower = faster recovery after a Steam restart but slightly more idle CPU; higher = calmer. 30 is a good balance.
// owner_settle_secs: When the renderer is present but UNCLAIMED, seconds to wait for another host (e.g. a plugin loader like the loader) to claim it before ShelvesHub hosts it itself. Default 25 is safe alongside another host (the primary setup) — a fast tick never hijacks a plugin the other host is about to load. Set 0 if ShelvesHub is the ONLY host, for an instant boot.
// native_qam: Show the native Steam Quick Access tab (real buttons/toggles). false ships the safe default; set true to enable it (also enabled per-service via SHELVES_NATIVE_QAM=1).
// prerelease: Consider pre-release Deck Shelves builds when obtaining or self-installing the bundle (the beta channel). false = stable releases only.
// force_owner: Claim renderer ownership even when another host is present, so the plugin selects ShelvesHub. Use only when you deliberately prefer ShelvesHub over another installed loader.
// recover_cmd: Shell command run ONCE if the daemon detects the Steam UI collapsed (a black screen where only SharedJSContext survives). Typically 'systemctl --user restart steam-launcher.service' on a Steam Deck. Empty = only pause injection and log the hint.
// target: Case-insensitive substring to force which renderer target is used. Empty = auto-detect the Steam shared JS context / Big Picture window (leave empty unless debugging).
